nodes.label: App Store Edition XcodeGen Spec
nodes.rationale: This spec is the App Store edition (Home Assistant, Philips Hue, Apple Home only); the Smart Life edition includes this file and adds the module on top, so one project definition serves both editions.

nodes.label: XcodeGen-Generated Xcode Project
nodes.rationale: The Xcode project is generated from YAML by xcodegen rather than checked in, so targets, entitlements and settings stay reviewable in small files.

nodes.label: HouseWidgets App Extension Target
nodes.rationale: The iPhone widget extension is a separate app-extension target built from the shared ../widgets/Sources and embedded into the app.

nodes.label: App Group and Keychain Entitlements
nodes.rationale: App Group and Keychain access groups are shared between the app and its widgets: the group holds the home they draw and the connections they use, so a widget can act without launching the app.

nodes.label: Declared Bonjour Service Types
nodes.rationale: iOS only browses the Bonjour types an app declares, so _housecontrol._tcp (Mac sync), _hue._tcp and _home-assistant._tcp are all listed in NSBonjourServices.

nodes.label: Bundled web/dist Resource Folder
nodes.rationale: The Vite build of ../web lands in the app as the folder 'dist', so the phone ships the same web UI as the Mac.

nodes.label: HomeKit Entitlement
nodes.rationale: com.apple.developer.homekit is requested on the iPhone app because the Mac cannot switch Apple Home devices.
